item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 10 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 10 #VISPRSD
Issued at 07:34 PM 06 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Cebu(Badian), #Leyte(Abuyog), #EasternSamar(Guiuan and Mercedes) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Cebu(Moalboal), #Leyte(Javier and Macarthur) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
